body_markdown:
What if managing company policies was simple and centralized?


The Affinity Policy Management Portal helps organizations create, distribute, and track policies in one place - so employees always know what’s expected, and teams always know who’s acknowledged what. No more scattered documents, outdated versions, or manual follow-ups.


In this webinar recording, we’ll show how teams use Affinity to manage the full policy lifecycle with clarity and consistency.


You’ll see how to:


- Create and manage policies with built-in version control


- Assign policies to the right employees or teams


- Collect acknowledgements and attestations automatically


- Track policy status in real time with a clear audit trail


Watch the recording to see how Affinity makes policy management easier, more transparent, and more reliable as your organization grows.
